attempts.prompt:
One continuous eight-second locked-off tripod shot at the existing inn front desk. The camera does not move: no pan, tilt, zoom, drift or reframing, and no cuts. Preserve the supplied starting frame exactly: the innkeeper behind the counter, dark hair tied back, olive-green cardigan over a cream shirt; the counter, desk bell, daffodils, laptop with its screen facing her and never visible to camera, blank cards and pen, beige corded desk phone, printed pages, open guest book, key rack, entrance door at left, window and trail at right, daylight. The guest at screen left: short brown hair, navy rain shell, daypack.

For the first second both stay as in the frame. Then the guest turns away from the counter at a calm, normal walking pace and walks out of frame to the left through the entrance, relaxed and friendly. The innkeeper's gaze follows him as he leaves, then her eyes move to the window at screen right with the trail outside, and she holds that look with a faint, warm smile.

She stays behind the counter the whole time. No speaking, no lip movement, no waving. No new person, prop, text, logo or sound. Nothing on the laptop, cards or book is readable. Real-time motion.

Static camera. The camera is fixed on a tripod and never moves for the whole eight seconds: no pan, no truck, no dolly, no tilt, no zoom, no reframing, no cuts. The first frame and the last frame have exactly the same framing; the counter, key rack, entrance door at left and window at right stay in exactly the same place in the frame.

Preserve the supplied starting frame exactly: the innkeeper seated behind the counter holding the brass key, dark hair tied back, olive-green cardigan over a cream shirt; the guest at screen left, navy rain shell, daypack; the counter, bell, daffodils, laptop with its screen facing her, blank cards and pen, beige desk phone, open guest book, daylight.

The guest turns and walks calmly out of frame to the left toward the entrance. The innkeeper stays seated in her place behind the counter the whole time. She watches him go, then turns her head to look out the window at screen right, and holds that look with a faint, warm smile, the key resting in her hand.

She does not stand up or walk. No speaking, no lip movement, no waving. No new person, prop, folder, text, logo or sound. Real-time motion.
